# Provenance comparison candidate only

These files were fetched from Python's cpython-bin-deps commit
94cb9a1c7feb608adf2b9f8fe2dbd6925ffbf90d (libffi-3.4.4).
The DLL is retained only for a read-only hash comparison. It is not executed,

validation/libffi-provenance-probe.json at the project root.
